title: Planar constant piecewise smooth vector fields with large hysteresis
summary: Throughout this work, we will carry out a rigorous mathematical analysis of a class of control systems that is widely used in applications but still lacks a consistent theoretical foundation for describing the types of limit sets that may arise from its dynamics. There are applications in which, for example, a treatment for a given disease is administered until the level of diseased cells falls below a prescribed threshold C1.
